propositions: The parent-first cascade walk is duplicated across claim.py and transition.py with identical cycle guards and TOCTOU re-checks but differing decision tables.

Extract the cascade walk (ancestor recursion, cycle detection, benign-race re-check, error rewrap) into a shared lifecycle_cascade.py module while keeping _CASCADING_EDGES in transition.py and claim.py's open-parent handling independent.
The shared cascade_parent_first must accept injected resolve_parent and advance callbacks so each caller maintains its own write primitive and recursion path.
All three cascading edges (open→in_progress, closed→open, closed→in_progress) must continue working unchanged after extraction; * → closed must not cascade.
A parametrised test over _CASCADING_EDGES driven through the real transition surface verifies every table row actually cascades, not just that the table exists.
